## Description

What problem does this PR solve? Describe the specific failure, error, or user experience that motivated this change. Link to any related issues.

## Existing PRs

Search for existing PRs (open AND closed) addressing this problem or a related area. Reference what you found here. If a prior PR was closed, explain specifically what is different about your approach.

## Changes

List the specific files changed and why each change was necessary. Do not submit bulk changes — one problem per PR.

## Testing

Describe how you tested this change. Include:
- Fresh Hermes session test results
- Acceptance test transcript (for harness/bootstrap changes)
- Before/after behavior comparison (for skill changes)
- Any adversarial pressure testing performed

## Checklist

- [ ] I read AGENTS.md before submitting
- [ ] I searched existing PRs (open and closed)
- [ ] This solves a real problem with specific symptoms
- [ ] My human partner reviewed the complete diff
- [ ] This is NOT a bulk PR or speculative fix
- [ ] Changes are limited to one problem
- [ ] No third-party dependencies added
- [ ] No project-specific configuration
- [ ] Skill changes include eval evidence (if applicable)
- [ ] Acceptance test transcript included (for harness changes)
